posts.title: AMD's 192GB Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 takes on Nvidia's RTX Spark
posts.excerpt: AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 carries up to 192GB of unified memory, per Tom's Guide. The timing is the tell: it lands two days before Nvidia's RTX Spark launch, rumored for Wednesday alongside…
posts.body: AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 carries up to 192GB of unified memory, [per Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/cpus/amd-just-flaunted-its-own-192gb-monster-chip-to-spoil-nvidias-rtx-spark-party-ryzen-ai-max-pro-495-should-worry-apple-too). The timing is the tell: it lands two days before Nvidia's RTX Spark launch, rumored for Wednesday alongside Microsoft, [per the same report](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/cpus/amd-just-flaunted-its-own-192gb-monster-chip-to-spoil-nvidias-rtx-spark-party-ryzen-ai-max-pro-495-should-worry-apple-too).

posts.title: Physics prize lands tomorrow morning
posts.excerpt: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announces the physics laureates Tuesday at 11:45 AM Stockholm time, 4:45 AM your time, with the reveal streamed live, per the week's schedule. The sequence…
posts.body: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announces the physics laureates Tuesday at 11:45 AM Stockholm time, 4:45 AM your time, with the reveal streamed live, [per the week's schedule](https://genznewz.com/nobel-prize-2026-begins-monday-medicine-to-peace-preview). The sequence closes with the economics prize next Monday, [per the AP's rundown](https://thehimalayantimes.com/photo-gallery/the-nobel-prize-week-is-kicking-off-in-stockholm-with-the-medicine-award).

posts.title: Isaias may form in the Gulf this week

posts.body: The National Hurricane Center raised the Gulf low's development odds this morning, with a tropical depression or storm now possible later this week, [per weather.com](https://weather.com/2026/10/05/storms/hurricane/video/gulf-tropical-development-chance-nhc-forecast-isaias). The northern Gulf Coast could see impacts this weekend, [per the same page](https://weather.com/2026/10/05/storms/hurricane/video/gulf-tropical-development-chance-nhc-forecast-isaias).

posts.title: Prime Big Deal Days starts tomorrow

posts.body:
Prime Big Deal Days opens at 12:01 AM PDT tomorrow and runs 48 hours, [per Don't Pay Full's run-up guide](https://www.dontpayfull.com/explore/amazon-prime-big-deal-days-deals), with fresh drops at midnight, 8 AM, and 1 PM PDT each day.
The U6 Pro sits at $648, so Tuesday morning's first wave is the one to measure your Best Buy cart against.
